selected_evidence.requirement: Users cannot remove files owned by other users (sticky bit enforcement)

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of /srv/drop and sticky-bit behavior

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: create shared group and directory ==="
sudo -n groupadd -f dropusers
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/drop
sudo -n chown root:dropusers /srv/drop
sudo -n chmod 1777 /srv/drop
stat -c '%A %U %G %a' /srv/drop

echo "=== STEP 2: create two test users in the group ==="
sudo -n useradd -m -G dropusers dropuser1 2>/dev/null || echo "dropuser1 exists"
sudo -n useradd -m -G dropusers dropuser2 2>/dev/null || echo "dropuser2 exists"
id dropuser1
id dropuser2

echo "=== STEP 3: verify sticky bit prevents cross-user deletion ==="
sudo -n -u dropuser1 touch /srv/drop/file-from-user1.txt
stat -c '%U %G %a %n' /srv/drop/file-from-user1.txt

echo "-- dropuser2 attempts to delete dropuser1's file (should FAIL) --"
if sudo -n -u dropuser2 rm -f /srv/drop/file-from-user1.txt 2>/tmp/rm_err.log; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: delete succeeded"
else
  echo "EXPECTED: delete denied"
  cat /tmp/rm_err.log
fi
ls -l /srv/drop/file-from-user1.txt

echo "-- dropuser2 writes its own file (should SUCCEED) --"
sudo -n -u dropuser2 touch /srv/drop/file-from-user2.txt
stat -c '%U %G %a %n' /srv/drop/file-from-user2.txt

echo "-- dropuser1 deletes its OWN file (should SUCCEED) --"
sudo -n -u dropuser1 rm -f /srv/drop/file-from-user1.txt
ls -l /srv/drop/ || true

echo "-- dropuser2 deletes its OWN file (cleanup, should SUCCEED) --"
sudo -n -u dropuser2 rm -f /srv/drop/file-from-user2.txt

echo "=== STEP 4: final state ==="
stat -c '%A %U %G %a %n' /srv/drop
ls -la /srv/drop

uptime -s

echo "=== POST-RESTART: /srv/drop persisted correctly ==="

ls -la /srv/drop

echo "=== POST-RESTART: sticky-bit protection still enforced ==="
id dropuser1
id dropuser2
sudo -n -u dropuser1 touch /srv/drop/postreboot-user1.txt
stat -c '%U %G %a %n' /srv/drop/postreboot-user1.txt

if sudo -n -u dropuser2 rm -f /srv/drop/postreboot-user1.txt 2>/tmp/rm_err2.log; then

fi
ls -l /srv/drop/postreboot-user1.txt

echo "-- cleanup by owner --"
